title: Taboo Game · Deterministic Multiplayer
description: *Taboo* is a **party game web app** for playing the classic word-guessing game across several phones in the same room, with **no server, no rooms, and no realtime sync**. Every device reconstructs the full game state — current turn, active player, the exact card on the table — from just a shared seed and turn number that the group agrees on verbally.

Built **100% by an AI coding agent** under my direction. The pure logic uses a **seeded mulberry32 PRNG** with **FNV-1a hashing** to pick the active player and a **deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle** to draw cards from a 550+ card Spanish deck. Roles (active describer, blind teammate, opposing judge) drive per-device UI visibility so each phone shows the right view of the same card. The dataset itself was generated by **18 parallel AI agents** across different themes and then deduplicated.

All shared state lives in URL query params for one-click invites; personal info (which team, which player) stays in localStorage. The deterministic logic is **fully TDD-covered** with Bun's test runner so the game-state contract is verifiable without a browser.
